learnings: Each decision diamond maps to one condition in the same order as the drawing.
Loop arrows become `while queue:`; process boxes become plain statements.
Storing a flowchart as data lets one interpreter run many charts, and it can detect cycles.
pitfalls: A flowchart test is strongest when it checks that the coded version and the data version agree for every input combination.
